🔥 Can you unlock the Sharingan?

👁️ Train your Chakra and wield the power of legendary anime eyes. Awaken the Rinnegan and Six Eyes, then put their abilities to the test against tougher bosses.

🖱️ Gain +1 Chakra per click and unlock over 128 anime eyes. Each has a unique ability and is stronger than the last.
⚔️ Fight through 15 stages of enemies and bosses, earn Trophies and climb the leaderboard.
🥚 Hatch pets for boosts, equip auras to multiply your Chakra, and rebirth to grow stronger. Your Chakra keeps growing offline!

🎁 Redeem codes UPDATE2, KURUMA and 1MILLIONVISITS
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support future updates!
